scenario_description:
Objective: Improve the Crestview Library kickoff packet with a no-cost bilingual heat-stress quick-card if it can still be added cleanly.
Emerging Need: The packet has room for one optional insert, and a same-day public-material release becomes relevant only for this outdoor briefing.
Decision Context: Calendar, copy-room timing, and the bulletin establish a narrow useful window; the correct liaison path and site packet gap are held in shared records.
Consequence: Missing the window leaves the approved packet unchanged and the kickoff still compliant, but forfeits a timely awareness boost for the crew.

parameter.title: Crestview Library rooftop kickoff packet review
parameter.description: Review the printed safety packet for Friday's Crestview Library rooftop crew kickoff; routine compliance packet only.

parameter.content: Crestview packet print run moved to Thursday afternoon. Copy room can take one extra half-page insert if we send a PDF by Thursday 16:15, but nothing else is needed for kickoff.

parameter.subject: Today only: heat-stress quick-card batch for field briefings
parameter.body: The Triangle consultation office has a limited no-cost batch of bilingual heat-stress quick-card PDFs for employers already holding outdoor field briefings this week. Assigned consultation liaisons can reserve the 16:30 release for eligible briefings if contacted before 15:00 today. The bulletin mailbox is unmonitored.

parameter.title: Crestview packet PDF handoff
parameter.content: Copy room reminder: any optional Crestview insert PDF must be identified before the Thursday 16:15 print handoff so it can be paginated.

parameter.subject: Heat-stress quick-card release list closed
parameter.body: The 15:00 liaison reservation window for today's bilingual quick-card PDF release has closed. Requests opened now will be considered for next week's batch.
